rules: Five dropdowns in the PO form's General Details: Form Type (the event's template, locked), Unit Name (the PR line's location, or the buyer's teams' units), Legal Entity (depends on Unit Name), Department, Nature of Expense. Sanction Note and Comments are notes only.

Only Bid Proposal workflows whose team includes the buyer in the stated role (Member/Manager/Admin) count. If any TEAM workflow matches, the COMPANY ones are ignored. Each condition means 'the PO's value is one of these'; every condition must hold; a field without a condition accepts any value. Total Proposal Value and the older conditions combine the same way.

One match: used. Several: the buyer picks. None: the PO cannot be submitted (never reachable on DLF UAT while the three company 'test' workflows exist). Required field empty: 'Please fill …'. Chosen workflow no longer matching: 'Invalid Approval' and the list reloads.
General Details become read-only; the request records the values, the workflow, how many matched and whether the buyer chose. Reject or withdraw → a new draft with the same values.

Form Type: event templates. Unit Name: the company's locations (34 on UAT, some junk). Legal Entity, Department, Nature of Expense: uploaded data rows, the entity rows mapped to units. The builder's values come from a sync script a developer runs.
